create_dqn_agent: create a DQN agent for the catch environment with configurable hidden layers and replay buffer
run_training_loop: run a DQN training loop on the open_spiel catch environment with periodic evaluation
evaluate_agent: evaluate a trained DQN agent on the catch environment and return average episode reward
configure_flags: configure training flags for number of episodes, evaluation frequency, and algorithm selection
step_agent_episode: step a DQN agent through an episode by repeatedly calling agent.step with environment time steps
